subject.title: feat(chat): switch between session transcript branches from the chat header

question: Should branch switching be committed as a supported public gateway API and Control UI recovery flow, including its explicit queue-clearing and rotated-session behavior?
rationale: The patch is additive but creates a durable external gateway contract and a user-visible persisted-session mutation; this requires maintainer intent beyond test coverage.

options.title: Approve the public branch-switch contract
options.body: Keep the two additive RPCs and chat-header flow after owner review confirms the documented mutation, authorization, and queue-clearing semantics.

options.title: Limit the initial surface
options.body: Retain the internal session capability but defer or narrow the public RPC/UI exposure until the long-term protocol contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the public branch-switch contract
recommendation.body: Keep the two additive RPCs and chat-header flow after owner review confirms the documented mutation, authorization, and queue-clearing semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete introduced the merged rewind/fork foundation and authored this direct follow-up on the same session-DAG boundary.
